name: MovieLens 20M Dataset
description: A stable benchmark dataset of 20 million ratings and tag applications from MovieLens users, including movie metadata, collected between 1995 and 2015 for recommender-system research.
citation: Harper, F. M., & Konstan, J. A. (2015). The MovieLens Datasets: History and Context. ACM Transactions on Interactive Intelligent Systems, 5(4), Article 19. https://doi.org/10.1145/2827872
